edits.old: No lake copy and no extract event exists.
edits.new:
No lake copy and no extract event exists.

The record follows DP-03: the calling service appends it locally in its own schema and transaction and publishes DecisionRecorded on `rwb.decision-record.v1` from its outbox, and rwb-decision collects it into the ledger. The legacy sentence on publication through one monolith writer is superseded, and no event comes from the client of rwb-agent.

Decision log mapping of an agent step: the entry carries the decision code in force from LOV-DECISION; `actions` holds agentRunId, mode, fallback and fallbackReason; `recommendation` and `final_call` stay separate fields. The code of an agent step is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2417) and is settled with the reference-data owner before the first joint environment.
